fishmeal.title: 600 MT/Day Fish Meal & Fish Oil Plant
fishmeal.text: Continuous wet processing — raw fish to fish meal, fish oil and soluble concentrate — with steam, energy recovery, wastewater and odour systems engineered around production demand.
fishmeal.caption: Concept visualization only — not an IFC drawing; process routing, capacities and dimensions to be verified. Click to enlarge.

models.title: Plant Models
models.subtitle: Compact, automated treatment packages. Final process is selected after water analysis and site assessment.
models.note: Images are AI-generated concept illustrations for presentation; final materials, layout and controls are application-specific.

items.title: Integrated STP / ETP with Intelligent Control
items.text: Modular STP / ETP configurations with membrane polishing, PLC control and online instruments. Final process, equipment and automation are selected after site and water-quality assessment.

items.title: UF / RO Systems with PLC Control
items.text: Automatic sequencing, pressure and conductivity monitoring, low-pressure protection and configured cleaning cycles. Instrumentation and interlocks are defined for each installation.

items.title: Single-package FRP ETP
items.text: Integrated effluent treatment with equalization, chemical treatment, biological treatment, clarification, filtration and disinfection. Separate UF polishing can be added after media filtration. Process selected after effluent testing.

items.title: Single-package FRP STP
items.text: Integrated sewage treatment with screening, equalization, anoxic and aerobic (MBBR) treatment, clarification and polishing. Separate UF can be integrated before disinfection. For apartments, hotels, institutions and commercial facilities.

items.title: Single-package FRP WTP
items.text: Compact package combining application-specific clarification, filtration, dosing and pumping for surface-water and process-water applications. Final configuration follows water analysis.

items.title: Packaged Desalination Plant
items.text: Seawater reverse osmosis with pretreatment, high-pressure pumping, membrane separation and control. Intake, product-water conditioning and brine management are engineered for the site.

items.title: Standalone Ultrafiltration System
items.text: Separate UF skid for suspended-solids removal and membrane-based water polishing, with automatic filtration and backwash sequences. Integrates after PSF / ACF and before RO or disinfection.

items.title: Standalone Reverse Osmosis System
items.text: Separate RO skid for dissolved-salt reduction with cartridge prefiltration, high-pressure pump and membranes. Feed-water analysis determines pretreatment, recovery, membrane selection and cleaning.
